title: Rewrite one semantic stage and replay downstream history
summary: Add a transactional CLI command that folds a fix commit into a selected stage, recreates downstream commits, moves the current branch, and refreshes artifact bindings.
rationale: Feedback application is the highest-risk Git operation in the workflow. It should be one deterministic command with explicit preconditions and rollback instead of agent-authored cherry-pick sequences.

decisions.summary: Construct rewritten commits with a temporary Git index and commit-tree before moving any branch reference.
decisions.rationale: The entire candidate stack can be built and validated for conflicts without mutating the worktree or published branch.

decisions.summary: Require one clean fix commit directly after the current semantic stack tip.
decisions.rationale: The agent can implement and test freely, then expose one bounded patch for deterministic folding into the selected stage.

risks.summary: A downstream stage patch may conflict with the rewritten parent.
risks.mitigation: Build through an isolated temporary index and leave the branch and artifact unchanged when any patch cannot apply.

validation.summary: Covers fix folding, downstream replay, artifact refresh, feedback resolution, and PR branch approval through rewrite-stage.
